question: Who among the following is credited with starting a Fusion Dance form called ‘Hi-Dance'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uday Shankar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Uday Shankar** is credited with starting a Fusion Dance form called 'Hi-Dance'.
 
• He was a pioneer in fusing Indian classical dance with Western dance forms, creating a unique and innovative style.
